Name: Seeds N' Saplings - Nando's Artisan Goods
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/jSv1Xov.png[/img]﻿[/center]

Seeds N' Saplings add-on for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29425]Nando's Artisan Goods[/url]﻿, can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29387]Seeds N' Saplings[/url], but will look best with the matching seedbags.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Aj354v4.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[u][b]Seasonal Seedbags[u] and Saplings[/u][/b][/u]
This option colour codes seedbags to their farming season. Green for spring, pink for summer, brown for autumn and blue for winter, just like the craftable wild seed bags. This is especially handy in case you happen to be forgetful like me and have many modded crops. There are two different Seasonal Options.

[u][b]Non Seasonal Seedbags[u] and Saplings[/u][/b][/u]
With this option, seedbags stay the same colour all year around, and has six different colour options to choose from.

[u][b]Multiple Designs[/b][/u]
Some seedbags have different designs for you to choose from, ranging from different sizes or selecting between a sack or bag.

[u][b]Seasonal Sapling Leaves[/b][/u]
The leaves on saplings will change with the seasons depending on the fully grown tree or bush. [i]Disabled by default.[/i]

[u][b]Different Sapling Designs[/b][/u]
You can pick between the usual, vanilla game's sack or a garden pot for tree saplings.

[u][b]Crop Textures[/b][/u]
Completely redone crop textures for all crops, multiple options for crops with wooden trellis, there's options for a darker wood colour, particularly to fit with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Gweniaczek?gameId=1303]Gwen's Medieval Series[/url] or [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch?gameId=1303]Bog's[/url]﻿ [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods?gameId=1303]Witchy series[/url]

[u][b]Highly Configurable[/b][/u]
This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/PoStKKx.png[/img]﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29425]Nando's Artisan Goods[/url]﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.

[center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/9oxH5zG.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿
